input_messages.content: Hi, I’m having trouble with my mobile data. The internet on my phone is either extremely slow or just stops working altogether. I really need to get excellent internet speed—nothing less will work for me. Can you help me fix this? I don’t have access to Wi-Fi, so I need my mobile data to work perfectly.
Sure, my name is John Smith and my phone number is 555-123-2002. Let me know if you need any more information to verify my account.
It looks like my phone is currently in Airplane Mode, and there’s no cellular service. Could this be the reason why my mobile data isn’t working? What should I do next?

I’ve turned off Airplane Mode. Now I see a poor signal with 2G on the status bar, and data is enabled. What should I do next to improve my internet speed? I still need excellent speed, not just any connection.

I’ve set my phone to prefer 4G and 5G networks, and now the status bar shows an excellent signal with 5G. Should I run a speed test now to check if my internet speed is excellent, or is there anything else you’d like me to do first?

I tried running a speed test, but it failed and said "No Connection," even though the status bar shows an excellent 5G signal. What should I do next? This is getting a bit frustrating—I really need excellent internet speed.

Here’s what I found from the checks you suggested:
- My phone is connected to 5G with excellent signal, and mobile data is enabled.
- The SIM card is active and working.
- Data Saver mode is ON, which might be limiting data usage.
- VPN is turned OFF.

What should I do next to get excellent internet speed?
I’ve turned off Data Saver mode. The status bar still shows an excellent 5G signal and data is enabled. Should I try running the speed test again now?

I ran the speed test again, but it still failed and says "No Connection," even though I have an excellent 5G signal and Data Saver mode is off. What else can we try? I really need to get excellent internet speed.

I checked my APN settings, and the APN name is set to "internet" with the default MMSC URL. Should I still go ahead and reset the APN settings to default and then reboot my device, or do you want me to try something else first?

I reset the APN settings and rebooted my device as you suggested, but the speed test still fails with "No Connection." I still have an excellent 5G signal and data enabled. What else can we try? I really need to get excellent internet speed.
